# iPolloWork English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**An enterprise collaboration platform for people and AI agents, built on the open-source DeepSeek Harness.** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/201b561a-22ec-4c8e-a4e8-f34172cf0aa3 [Download the original demo](docs/assets/ipollowork-demo.mp4) iPolloWork brings multi-agent teams, shared projects, plugins, Skills and editable work into one workspace. A main assistant coordinates specialists; people share context, follow progress and continue working together across code, documents, presentations, websites, design and video. The video above is the original iPolloWork demo. The current `main` branch uses the native DeepSeek Harness runtime; the earlier multi-engine edition remains on [`ipollowork-multi-engine`](https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/tree/ipollowork-multi-engine).

Join the official iPolloWork WeChat community

Scan with WeChat for product updates and community discussions.

## What makes it different - **People and agent teams** — use a main assistant, reusable specialists and native task delegation in the same workspace. - **Enterprise projects** — organize members and departments, grant project access, share files and project memory, and review submitted changes. - **Live collaboration** — share a native conversation, let authorized people view or participate, and continue independently through a fork. - **Plugins and Skills** — use the native plugin lifecycle and curated market, with integrated messaging and project-specific agent instructions. - **Editable creative work** — use Design and Video views for presentations, websites and visual production, then keep editing the result. - **Shared services and app data** — discover account-authorized AI capabilities over HTTP and give small apps a record store without their own database. - **[Project Board](plugins/collaboration-board/README.md)** — A suite component with a conversation tab for project tasks, scheduling, dependencies, organization assignments and notifications. - **[Notification Center](plugins/notification-center/README.md)** — A suite component with one inbox beside the account avatar for conversation and plugin notifications. ## Start from source Use Node.js **^24.22.3 or >=26.13.1** and **pnpm 11.28.5**. Run these commands in a terminal on macOS or Linux: ```sh git clone --branch main https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork.git cd iPolloWork npm run setup:build npm run build npm start ``` The same commands work in Windows PowerShell. `npm start` uses the compiled pinned DSH launcher, preserves the profile, and configures the reviewed Studio dependency builds. Open the local address printed by the launcher. The suite adds iPolloWork's account, agents and plugin views to the native Web UI. Sign in for configured account services and organization features; local model providers keep their own credentials. Do not paste an account or provider key into a project page. The account service is deployed separately. Its [setup guide](services/ipollowork/README.md) covers PostgreSQL, account configuration and storage; [capability API documentation](services/ipollowork/docs/capabilities.md) covers external HTTP access. The suite uses iPolloWork Cloud by default; configure `accountOrigin` as described in the [suite guide](plugins/ipollowork-suite/README.md) for your own service. ## Desktop and development The source Web UI runs on macOS, Windows and Linux. Native desktop development and installer packaging use the [Desktop guide](integrations/desktop/README.md) and [packaging guide](integrations/desktop/packaging/README.md). Published files on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/releases) may belong to the earlier multi-engine edition; check the release description before installing. For ongoing development, see the [development guide](integrations/runtime/README.md), [integration overview](integrations/README.md) and [delivery guide](integrations/delivery.md). Agent instructions live in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). DeepSeek Harness remains the execution runtime; this branch does not start a second agent engine. ## Community and contributing Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/issues) for iPolloWork bugs and requests. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting changes and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) before running agent tasks. The upstream runtime is maintained by [DeepSeek](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Repository edits and Git submissions follow the shared [Git workflow skill](.agents/skills/github-sync-pr-flow/SKILL.md). Normal setup installs its Git checks; existing checkouts can run `npm run setup:git`. ## Star History

## License Owned iPolloWork code uses the [iPolloWork Source Available License](LICENSE). This is source-available software, not an unrestricted MIT grant. Third-party code and previously granted licenses remain under their original terms; see [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Git history and original author attribution are retained when upstream files are removed from the current tree. ## Synchronized release mirrors [Release mirror automation](.github/workflows/release-mirror.yml) copies the original GitHub release assets to S3-compatible mainland storage; it never rebuilds a second version. Each local download and each public mirror download must match GitHub's SHA-256 digest and size before a verified manifest is exposed. Published release changes trigger synchronization; after all platform assets reach a draft, dispatch the workflow with its tag to mirror, verify, and publish it. Failed copies are retryable and do not publish the draft. Configure the `release-mirror` GitHub environment once: variables `IPOLLO_MIRROR_S3_ENDPOINT`, `IPOLLO_MIRROR_BUCKET`, `IPOLLO_MIRROR_PUBLIC_URL`, `IPOLLO_MIRROR_REGION`; secrets `IPOLLO_MIRROR_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `IPOLLO_MIRROR_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`. The public origin must serve the bucket's `releases//` paths over HTTPS without redirects. Use a dedicated mainland bucket with write access restricted to this prefix. Missing configuration fails explicitly; an unconfigured workflow is not an active mainland mirror. Published desktop versions use three numeric parts (for example `1.0.2`). A GitHub Latest release must include `stable-mac.yml` and `stable.yml` plus every referenced ZIP/installer; the release title alone cannot notify installed clients. Generate and verify feeds with `integrations/tooling/release-update-feed.mjs` before publication. The standard publication entrypoint is **Actions → Publish verified iPolloWork release** (`ipollo-publish.yml`). Upload the signed and notarized Apple Silicon/Intel DMGs, update ZIPs, blockmaps, clean-build records, Windows installer and current Design/suite packages to a numeric draft. Then dispatch this workflow with the tag. It rejects incomplete drafts and versions older than Latest, verifies every downloaded byte against GitHub, generates both update feeds and checksums, publishes Latest, and checks the public feeds and referenced downloads. A failed public check restores the previous Latest. The mirror workflow receives the same finalized files; it does not rebuild them. Do not publish a draft manually or promote a test suffix to Latest. ## Independent plugins [Plugin development standard (Chinese)](docs/plugin-development.zh.md) · [Word document](docs/plugin-development.zh.docx) · [Plugin development skill](.agents/skills/ipollowork-plugin-development/SKILL.md) [Data annotation training](plugins/data-annotation/README.md) and [Operation recorder](plugins/operation-recorder/README.md) are separately installable DSH bundles. They reuse official authentication, workspaces and plugin lifecycle; neither modifies the DSH runtime. Recorder exports installable DSH Skill bundles. Independent plugins are distributed separately through the plugin marketplace; do not bundle them in the iPolloWork application installer.

# iPolloWork [English](README.md) | 中文

**面向人与 AI 智能体团队的企业级协作平台，基于开源 DeepSeek Harness 构建。** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/201b561a-22ec-4c8e-a4e8-f34172cf0aa3 [下载原版演示视频](docs/assets/ipollowork-demo.mp4) iPolloWork 把多 Agent 团队、共享项目、插件、Skills 和可编辑成果放进同一个工作空间。总助手协调专业智能体，人可以共享上下文、查看进度，并围绕代码、文档、演示文稿、网站、设计和视频继续协作。 上方保留 iPolloWork 原版演示视频。当前 `main` 分支使用原生 DeepSeek Harness 运行时；之前的多引擎版保留在 [`ipollowork-multi-engine`](https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/tree/ipollowork-multi-engine) 分支。

加入 iPolloWork 官方微信交流群

使用微信扫码，获取产品更新并参与社区交流。

## 主要能力 - **人与智能体团队协作** — 在同一个工作空间使用总助手、可复用专业智能体和原生任务委派。 - **企业项目** — 组织成员和部门，授予项目权限，共享文件与项目记忆，并审核提交的改动。 - **实时协作** — 分享原生会话，让获授权的人查看或参与，也可以通过分支独立继续。 - **插件与 Skills** — 沿用原生插件生命周期和精选市场，集成即时通信与项目专属智能体指令。 - **可编辑创作** — 使用 Design、Video 页面制作演示文稿、网站和视觉内容，生成后继续编辑。 - **共享服务与应用数据** — 通过 HTTP 发现账号获授权的 AI 能力，为小型应用提供记录存储，无需另建数据库。 - **[项目看板](plugins/collaboration-board/README.zh.md)** — 套件子插件，在对话顶部提供项目任务、排期、前置依赖、组织指派和通知。 - **[通知中心](plugins/notification-center/README.zh.md)** — 套件子插件，在头像旁汇总会话未读和插件通知。 ## 从源码启动 需要 **Node.js ^24.22.3 或 >=26.13.1**及 **pnpm 11.28.5**。在 macOS 或 Linux 终端执行： ```sh git clone --branch main https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork.git cd iPolloWork npm run setup:build npm run build npm start ``` Windows PowerShell 使用相同命令。`npm start` 使用编译后的固定版本 DSH 启动器，保留现有配置，并配置已审核的 Studio 依赖构建规则。 打开启动器输出的本地地址。套件会在原生 Web 界面中加入 iPolloWork 的账号、智能体和插件页面。已配置的账号服务和组织功能需要登录；本地模型提供方继续使用各自的凭据。不要把账号或供应商 Key 粘贴进项目页面。 账号服务单独部署。[部署说明](services/ipollowork/README.zh.md)介绍 PostgreSQL、账号配置和存储；[能力 API 文档](services/ipollowork/docs/capabilities.md)介绍对外 HTTP 接入。套件默认连接 iPolloWork 云服务；自建服务请按[套件说明](plugins/ipollowork-suite/README.zh.md)配置 `accountOrigin`。 ## 桌面端与开发 源码 Web 界面可在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 运行。原生桌面开发和安装包构建参见[桌面说明](integrations/desktop/README.zh.md)及[打包说明](integrations/desktop/packaging/README.zh.md)。[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/releases)中的已发布文件可能属于之前的多引擎版，安装前请查看对应版本说明。 日常开发参见[开发指南](integrations/runtime/README.zh.md)、[集成概览](integrations/README.zh.md)和[交付说明](integrations/delivery.zh.md)。智能体工作规范见 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。本分支使用 DeepSeek Harness 执行任务，不会另启一套智能体引擎。 ## 社区与贡献 通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/issues)提交 iPolloWork 问题和需求。贡献前请阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，运行智能体任务前请阅读 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。上游运行时由 [DeepSeek](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)维护。 仓库修改和 Git 提交统一遵循 [Git 协作 Skill](.agents/skills/github-sync-pr-flow/SKILL.md)。 正常 setup 会安装配套 Git 检查；已有副本执行 `npm run setup:git` 即可启用。 ## Star History

## 许可证 iPolloWork 自有代码使用原有的 [iPolloWork Source Available License](LICENSE)，属于源码可用软件，不是无限制的 MIT 授权。第三方代码及此前已授予的许可继续适用原条款，详见[第三方声明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。从当前目录移除上游文件不会删除 Git 历史和原作者记录。 ## 全球与大陆镜像同步发布 [发布镜像流程](.github/workflows/release-mirror.yml) 将 GitHub Release 的原始文件复制到兼容 S3 的大陆存储，不重新构建第二个版本。本地下载和大陆公开下载都必须通过 GitHub SHA-256 与文件大小校验，才会公开验证清单。已发布版本的变更自动触发同步；所有平台文件进入草稿后，使用版本标签启动该流程，即可完成镜像、验证并发布草稿。复制失败可以重试，并且不会发布草稿。 在 GitHub 的 `release-mirror` environment 中配置一次：变量 `IPOLLO_MIRROR_S3_ENDPOINT`、`IPOLLO_MIRROR_BUCKET`、`IPOLLO_MIRROR_PUBLIC_URL`、`IPOLLO_MIRROR_REGION`；密钥 `IPOLLO_MIRROR_ACCESS_KEY_ID`、`IPOLLO_MIRROR_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`。公开地址须通过 HTTPS 直接提供存储桶中的 `releases//`，不经过跳转。使用专用大陆存储桶，并把写权限限制在此路径。缺少配置会明确失败；未配置的流程不代表大陆镜像已经上线。 桌面发布版本仅使用三段数字（例如 `1.0.2`）。GitHub Latest 必须同时包含 `stable-mac.yml`、`stable.yml` 及其中引用的 ZIP／安装器；仅修改发布标题无法通知已安装的客户端。发布前使用 `integrations/tooling/release-update-feed.mjs` 生成并验证更新清单。 固定发布入口为 **Actions → Publish verified iPolloWork release**（`ipollo-publish.yml`）。先将已签名公证的 Apple Silicon／Intel DMG、更新 ZIP、blockmap、干净构建记录、Windows 安装器及当前设计／套件插件上传到纯数字版本草稿，再输入该标签启动流程。流程会拒绝缺包和旧版本，逐个核对 GitHub 下载文件的哈希，生成两个更新索引及校验文件，发布 Latest，并检查公开更新索引和下载地址。公开检查失败会恢复上一版 Latest。镜像流程接收同一批最终文件，不重新构建。不要手动发布草稿，也不要把带测试后缀的版本设为 Latest。 ## 独立插件 [插件开发规范](docs/plugin-development.zh.md) · [Word 版](docs/plugin-development.zh.docx) · [插件开发 Skill](.agents/skills/ipollowork-plugin-development/SKILL.md) [数据标注实训云](plugins/data-annotation/README.zh.md)和[操作录制](plugins/operation-recorder/README.zh.md)分别打包为可独立安装的 DSH 插件，使用官方认证、工作区和插件生命周期，不修改 DSH 运行时。操作录制生成的 Skill 也可作为 DSH 插件安装。独立插件通过插件市场单独分发，不捆绑进 iPolloWork 主程序安装包。
